Born on August 6, 1998, in Russia, she has garnered a substantial following on platforms like Instagram, where she shares fashion and modeling content, often featuring swimwear and lingerie. As of now, her Instagram account, musatovaak, boasts over 2.1 million followers. 

Beyond modeling, Kristina has a passion for cosplay, having portrayed characters such as Spider-Man and Little Red Riding Hood. She launched her Instagram account in April 2017, and her engaging content has significantly contributed to her rising popularity.
